image_rule: for each radius B, enumerate all integer pairs -B<=a,b<=B and take (a+R_over_Q*b) mod q; include zero in the image, count nonidentity separately
threshold_rule: first scanned B whose scalar image equals all q residues; preserve every radius row and status through B=128
verification: check source panel hash, exact source p/q/radius/scalar, independently reconstruct reduced Q and R group points in checked Sage, and directly compare scalar image to elliptic-curve point image at first complete radius and the immediately preceding radius
claim_boundary: fixed two cells selected and measured in the prior preregistered panel; exact coefficient-box image threshold, not an inference about untested curves or rational-coordinate cost
